prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: painterly mold growth COLOR + REAL ALPHA source for a seamless repeatable dungeon-surface overlay texture. Render only a flat mold growth pattern viewed directly from ABOVE, no perspective. Make one sprawling organic colony with several irregular connected growth zones and open transparent gaps, fully visible on a SQUARE 1024x1024 canvas with about 6 percent transparent space around the outer silhouette. The final pattern will be wrapped and overlapped for tiling, so vary dense/sparse regions and scales. Style: hand-painted gouache/oil fantasy game material, broad readable painterly color planes plus carefully painted smaller material marks; not a photograph, CGI, pixel art, outline drawing, procedural cell noise or evenly sized Voronoi blobs. Real transparent background, fully opaque solid mold bodies and clear empty gaps, clean cutout contours with narrow edge antialiasing; no colored fringe, keyed green, fake checkerboard, opaque backing or surrounding wall/stone/soil. Neutral uniform ambient material lighting, no cast shadow, vignette, big directional light or glow spill. No mushroom caps, grass, leaves, moss fronds, rocks, scene, props, text, labels, borders or watermark. Match a muted weathered dark-fantasy dungeon palette.
Mold variant 06: Dense granular spore mold in dusty ochre, old mustard, olive-brown and faded parchment accents. Numerous tiny irregular painted granules in asymmetrical spreading lobes, mixed coarse and fine growth, no uniform dot grid. Muted natural dungeon colors, not bright yellow.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: VERY SPARSE painterly mold growth texture source for a repeatable dungeon-surface overlay. Composition: directly top-down, SQUARE 1024x1024, genuine transparent background covering AT LEAST 80 to 90 PERCENT of the canvas. Only 6 to 10 small scattered irregular mold colonies, a few tiny detached satellite speckles and short threadlike wisps. Colonies should be uneven sizes and unevenly spaced with broad bare gaps between them. Each main colony should occupy only about 3 to 8 percent of the image width. No giant central colony, continuous carpet or connected network spanning the canvas. Keep about 5 percent transparent space at image edges. Opaque painted mold interiors with clean open alpha gaps, narrow antialiasing only; do not make the colonies faint or translucent to simulate sparsity. Texture/material: hand-painted gouache/oil for a muted fantasy dungeon, directional brush strokes, simplified painted color planes, carefully painted fuzzy/powdery/crusty small marks. Organic uneven colony edges, no regular Voronoi/cell pattern, no dot grid. Flat low growth, not a scene or upright plants. No backing wall, stone, floor, soil, mushrooms, grass, leaves, moss fronds, text, border, label, watermark, fake checkerboard, keyed green, colored fringe, dramatic directional light or cast background shadow. Real transparency, muted natural colors, no neon or bloom. The clear empty spaces are the main feature.
Color and material character: Dense granular spore mold in dusty ochre, old mustard, olive-brown and faded parchment accents. Numerous tiny irregular painted granules in asymmetrical spreading lobes, mixed coarse and fine growth, no uniform dot grid. Muted natural dungeon colors, not bright yellow.
Apply this character only to the small isolated growths. Keep at least 80 to 90 percent of the square transparent.
